notes.general_comments:
Questions 1, 2, 4, 9 and 13 proved to be particularly straightforward for candidates.
Candidates found Questions 14, 15, 30, 32, 35, 38 and 40 the most challenging.
Questions 14 and 30 all had an approximately equal number of candidates choosing each alternative
suggesting that a high proportion of candidates were guessing the answer.
